message.content:
Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images show a fetal lung mass composed of numerous small cysts (microcystic appearance) with no internal vascular flow on color Doppler, which is characteristic of Congenital Cystic Adenomatoid Malformation (CCAM/CPAM) Type II. Type I consists of large macrocysts (>2 cm), and Type III appears as a solid echogenic mass with microscopic cysts; the absence of a systemic feeding vessel helps distinguish it from pulmonary sequestration.
